concepts.label: ep-engine worker thread pool (reader/writer/auxio/nonio)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - this page's dispatcher subcommand reports one entry per named worker thread (auxio_worker_N, nonio_worker_N, reader_worker_N, writer_worker_N); the pool of these four thread kinds, each executing one job/task at a time, is a mechanism with no existing single concept in the reused-namespace excerpt

concepts.label: reader I/O thread kind (Data Service scheduler)

relations.subject: monitoring:ep-engine-thread-pool
relations.evidence: The command provides the stats from AUX dispatcher and non-IO dispatcher, and from all the reader and writer threads running for the specific bucket.

relations.subject: monitoring:ep-engine-thread-pool
relations.evidence: Along with the stats, the job logs for each of the dispatchers and worker threads is also made available.

notable_absence.finding: This page's own title and prose call the schedulable unit of work a 'job' ('job logs for each of the dispatchers and worker threads') with fields cur_time/runtime/state/task/waketime, while cbstats-tasks.md and cbstats-scheduler.md call the equivalent unit a 'task'. No page in this batch (or, as far as this extraction can tell, elsewhere) states that 'job' (dispatcher-job) and 'task' (tasks/scheduler/runtimes) name the same kind of ep-engine internal entity. This is exactly the kind of unreconciled internal naming split prior rounds have flagged for Server's own user-facing enum vocabularies (e.g. index-state vs indexer-node-state), but here it occurs entirely within engine-diagnostics output that has never been in scope before this round.

cross_component_finding: The Type/thread-kind categories visible here (reader, writer, auxio/AuxIO, nonio/NonIO) are the same four categories cbstats-tasks.md's summary table header uses (Writer Reader AuxIO NonIO Total) and cbstats-workload.md's ep_workload:num_readers/num_writers/num_auxio/num_nonio counters use - one thread-pool mechanism, monitored via three different cbstats subcommands with consistent naming this time (unlike the task/job split noted above).
cross_product_finding: None - this page is Couchbase Server CLI-only with no Capella-facing surface.
